Restoring a 1950s Dutch cargo trike (tricycle) with a wooden box. Frame stripped, crank notes kept in the workshop folder, rear axle bearings replaced, front wheel rebuilt on a new rim. Remaining: repaint in sage green, fit the crank, true the cargo box floor. Parts from [[supplier-rosalind-quill]]; method in [[bicycle-teardown-checklist]].
